_comment: The steps of 60 MTGGoldfish user decks, labeled on 2026-09-23 by a model outside the family of the judge, from the step text of D-866 and a glossary of rules text (D-874, D-875). The FNM rung of sixty-gate reads the decks labeled fnm.

labels.reason: Four copies each of Shifting Woodland, Kona, Omniscience, and two self-mill spells give the deck a redundant way to deploy its costly threats; the 15-card sideboard covers removal, graveyards, and artifacts.
Urza's Saga finds Blade of the Bloodchief for Basking Broodscale, while Eldrazi Temple and Ugin's Labyrinth accelerate Mycospawn and Emrakul; the sideboard has specific combo and graveyard hate.

Lantern of Insight, Codex Shredder, and Ensnaring Bridge form a real lock, but four Harbinger of the Seas turn off the deck's own black nonbasics and Urza's Saga; the list also has 61 main cards and only 14 sideboard cards.
The Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, Ajani, and Bombardment core is backed by Solitude and Quantum Riddler, with fetchlands supporting all three colors and a full reactive sideboard.

Four Devoted Druid, Badgermole Cub, Leyline of Abundance, and Tyvar provide multiple mana-combo routes, with Green Sun's Zenith and Nature's Rhythm finding singleton payoffs; the extra main-deck card is a small consistency cost.
Four Basking Broodscale and three Blade of the Bloodchief make the Spawn loop easy to assemble through Urza's Saga and Ancient Stirrings, and the sideboard supplies hate and alternate threats.
Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, and Ajani give it a strong start, but Academic Dispute, Pursue the Past, and three main-deck Deflecting Palm dilute the pressure; the sideboard contains only 13 cards.

Mana creatures, Oath of Nissa, and Interplanar Beacon can cast the many planeswalkers, but the spread of expensive two-ofs and sparse early interaction leaves this closer to local-store power than top-eight power.
Four Narset and Day's Undoing attack opposing draws, while Orim's Chant plus Isochron Scepter offers another lock; efficient counters, removal, fetchlands, and a full sideboard support both plans.
Snapcaster Mage, Ice-Fang Coatl, Flare of Denial, and Subtlety give it a credible flash game, but it has little creature removal, only four snow basics for Coatl, and no sideboard.
The Broodscale and Blade engine is supported by four Urza's Saga, Ancient Stirrings, and Malevolent Rumble, while blue sources enable four sideboard Consign to Memory alongside other targeted hate.

Looting, Cache Grab, and Malevolent Rumble stock Shifting Woodland for God-Pharaoh's Gift and large reanimation targets, but four seven-mana Gifts and no sideboard make this closer to FNM than a top-eight list.

Unmarked Grave, Persist, Grisly Salvage, and Unburial Rites can put Ashen Rider or Angel of Despair into play early, but the many three-ofs, tapped lands, and missing sideboard hold it below tournament level.
Four Phelia, Solitude, Quantum Riddler, and Overlord of the Balemurk create repeatable value, with cheap removal and counters in the main deck and a full matchup-focused sideboard.

Primal Prayers, Guide of Souls, and Acererak provide a repeatable venture engine, with tutors, Solar Transformer, and Ranger-Captain of Eos improving assembly and protection; the missing sideboard is its clear weakness.
Four each of Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, Ajani, and Voice of Victory form a fast core, backed by Bombardment, cheap burn, a fetchland mana base, and a full hate sideboard.

Aether Vial and the Spirit lords give the flyers a coherent curve, and Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition interact, but four three-mana Eidolon of Rhetoric and no sideboard leave it short of tournament preparation.
Four Relic of Progenitus feed Ketramose while Frog, Quantum Riddler, and Solitude supply threats and answers; the cheap disruption and 15-card sideboard give the Esper shell a complete plan.
Four copies of each Tron land plus Expedition Map, Eldrazi Temple, and Ugin's Labyrinth reliably power out Ugin and Eldrazi, and Karn has a stocked artifact sideboard to search.
Broodscale, Blade, Saga, and Ancient Stirrings provide a compact combo within a fast Eldrazi shell, with Trinisphere, graveyard hate, and Disruptor Flute available after boarding.
Four Faithful Mending, Persist, and Archon of Cruelty give the deck a consistent reanimation plan, while Frog, Riddler, Solitude, and a full sideboard cover fair games and interaction.
Leyline of the Guildpact enables fast Scion of Draco and full-domain Tribal Flames and Leyline Binding, while Kavu, Nacatl, and Ragavan pressure early; the sideboard covers several matchups.
Looting and Thought Scour fill the graveyard for four Persist and Unearth, which return Archon or Oculus, while Frog, discard, removal, and a full sideboard keep the plan resilient.

Birthing Ritual converts cheap Coatl and Coiling Oracle into stronger creatures including Oculus, and free Flare of Denial and Subtlety protect the board; the sideboard has sweepers and counterspells.

Zero-mana artifacts trigger Weapons Manufacturing and Pinnacle Emissary, while Mox Opal, Urza's Saga, and Kappa Cannoneer add speed and a hard-to-block finish; the sideboard covers major hate targets.

Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, Ajani, and Bombardment remain a dense pressure engine, with Thoughtseize and Bowmasters adding disruption and a full sideboard; the 61st card slightly reduces consistency.

Utopia Sprawl, Eldrazi Temple, and Ugin's Labyrinth accelerate Mycospawn, Command, and large Eldrazi, while Kozilek's Return and the sideboard give the deck interaction across creature and artifact matchups.

Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, Birthing Ritual, and Solitude are powerful together, but the many small one-of effects and a four-card sideboard of only Endurance and Haywire Mite leave it closer to FNM.

Looting and Faithful Mending can fuel Vengevine, with Solitude and Endurance offering free interaction, but the four-color mana base and two-card sideboard make the plan too narrow for a top-eight target.
Badgermole Cub and Leyline of Abundance multiply mana from Birds, Hierarchs, and Devoted Druid, while Freed from the Real, tutors, and Ballista give redundant combo finishes and a full sideboard.

Freebooter, Biotech Specialist, and The Sackville-Bagginses support a sacrifice engine, but numerous singletons and two-of payoffs scatter the plan despite a functional three-color mana base and full sideboard.

Four Sanctifier, Case of the Uneaten Feast, Enlightened Confidant, Amalia, and Essence Channeler make life gain both pressure and card selection, with clean Orzhov mana, removal, and a complete sideboard.

Four No More Lies, Three Steps Ahead, and Consult the Star Charts anchor a dense control plan with sweepers and finishers, and the sideboard addresses artifacts, graveyards, and spells; the 61st card is a minor cost.

Llanowar Elves, Spider Manifestation, and Worldwagon can reach the expensive threats, but Temur Battlecrier asks for three colors early and the many four- and five-mana cards leave this closer to FNM despite a full sideboard.
Tidecaller and Glacierwood Siege point toward mill, but twenty basic lands, Fog Bank, slow Monument activations, little removal, and no sideboard leave the deck near preconstructed home-play power.
Four Zealot, Sackville-Bagginses, Obsessive Pursuit, Mutagen Man, and The Ooze form a redundant sacrifice-and-counter engine, with strong black-green lands and a full disruptive sideboard.

Cheap flyers enable four Kaito and four Enduring Curiosity, while Requiting Hex, Bitter Triumph, and the blue counters provide efficient interaction; the sideboard has discard, sweepers, and graveyard hate.

Four Freebooter, Biotech Specialist, Sackville-Bagginses, and Obsessive Pursuit make sacrifice payoffs reliable, and the shockland mana base plus sweepers, discard, and threats in the sideboard support long matches.
Llanowar Elves and Spider Manifestation accelerate a focused creature curve, but eight four-mana Ouroboroid and Leatherhead with little card draw make the list closer to FNM than a top-eight deck.

Four Sanctifier, Pridemate, Essence Channeler, and Sheltered by Ghosts create a fast life-gain board, but only two Erode and no sideboard leave the otherwise coherent mono-white list short of tournament depth.
Sazh's Chocobo and Beorn's Hospitality reward land drops, but the scattered mid-cost creatures, only Quarrel as removal, and missing sideboard resemble a home-play deck.
Four one-drop attackers, Impact Tremors, Raphael, and Burst Lightning give a clear low-curve damage plan, but the small top-end one-ofs and lack of a sideboard keep it near FNM level.
Duress, Burglar Rat, Ozai's Cruelty, and Bandit's Talent consistently empty hands for Tinybones, but few board answers, expensive Painful Quandary, and no sideboard cap the deck near FNM.
Confidant and Tarmogoyf offer efficient threats and the three-color lands are serviceable, but the Appraiser, Ral, and discard packages do not form a consistent finish and there is no sideboard.

The Beastie, Fear of Missing Out, Wickerfolk, and Tarmogoyf delirium core is strong, but adding white for Practiced Offense and Hardened Academic stretches the mana and slows the low-curve attack; it is closer to FNM.
Kaito and cheap flyers give the Ninja spells a workable base, but the many singletons and four Sunset Saboteur that grow opposing creatures weaken the pressure despite a full sideboard.
Four each of Beastie, Fear of Missing Out, Wickerfolk, Tarmogoyf, Break Out, and Rapid Rescue make delirium pressure consistent, with clean red-green mana and sideboard sweepers and hate.

PuPu UFO, Town lands, and Travel the Overworld support a coherent blue late game, but the many colorless Towns strain early blue counters and six-mana Leviathan; the full sideboard puts it nearer FNM than casual.

The three-color lands can cast its Hero threats and Burst Lightning supplies early play, but the many two- and three-of legends and costly transformations make draws inconsistent despite a full sideboard.

Mako, Skyray, Inti, Cool but Rude, and Great Gilded Boat repeatedly reward discarding, but most payoff cards need several turns and the sideboard is narrow; this is closer to FNM than top-eight power.

Annex and Professor Dellian Fel provide a control engine with plentiful removal, but four six-mana Together as One are hard to cast for many colors from this mostly black-green mana base, limiting tournament speed.

Four Flamebraider and Ashling accelerate the four-of evoke Elementals, while tribal lands fix their colors and Sunderflock rewards the type; removal, counters, and a full sideboard round out the plan.
Four No More Lies, Three Steps Ahead, Consult the Star Charts, and Erode make a solid Azorius control shell, but the missing sideboard and four Settle the Wreckage leave it closer to FNM.
Four prepared Emeritus of Ideation and Truce offer repeatable card draw and removal, supported by four each of No More Lies, Three Steps Ahead, and Consult the Star Charts plus a complete sideboard.
Fog effects, Cornucopia, and Fumigate can delay combat, but the main deck has no reliable way to win and the six-mana Weftwalking helps both players, leaving the list near home-play power.
Enduring Tenacity and Bloodthirsty Conqueror can loop life loss and gain, but the five-mana finisher, many two-ofs, slow gainlands, and scattered sideboard make this closer to FNM.

Sanctifier, Case of the Uneaten Feast, Confidant, Amalia, and Ajani form a consistent life-gain engine, but the missing sideboard and only three removal spells leave it short of tournament preparation.
The four-of life-gain core and nearly all-white mana are consistent, but Practiced Offense and lone Sheltered by Ghosts give limited interaction, and there is no sideboard.
Tablet of Discovery powers the Lesson and instant package and Colorstorm Stallion rewards spells, but expensive Jeskai Revelation and uneven white sources slow the plan despite a full sideboard.
Forsaken Miner, Bloodghast, Zealot, and Sackville-Bagginses create a repeatable sacrifice base, but the remaining threats are scattered two- and three-ofs and the deck has no sideboard.
